name: Terminal type-on
looks: A dark, rounded code or command panel types on character by character at a steady rate, mono face, with a blinking block cursor advancing with the text. The call completes, and a status line or result appears below a hairline rule as the payoff.
build: DOM text revealed per character at a steady rate (kit.typeOn), monospace, one voice. The cursor is a blinking ::after block on the beat. The panel may pop in (0.9->1, power3.out) before typing starts. The status line reveals after a short pause: a coloured dot plus a word, fading and sliding up 4-6px.
sound: A soft mechanical key tick per character, and a single confirm tone on the status line.
prompt: Show the product's real call in a dark code or command panel, typing on character by character with a blinking cursor, then reveal a short status line or result as the payoff. Keep the command and result true to what the product actually does.
source: a Lightspark social promo in prompt-motion.com's gallery (prompt-motion.com/davidmarcus-a28a60), studied 2026-10-09
